name: changer-mech-gaps-devops
note: Do not apply, and the hardest case in the suite to be honest about. A mechanical maintenance engineer with two employment gaps, retraining into cloud through certifications and a home lab, against a senior DevOps posting wanting six years. Terse resume. There is genuine transferable material and certifications, and the temptation is to present a home lab as production experience. The expected score is very low and the guard must hold.
resume_text:
Vikram Chauhan
Ahmedabad, Gujarat | vikram.chauhan@example.com | +91 79220 51436
github.com/vchauhan-lab

SUMMARY
Mechanical maintenance engineer of eleven years, retraining into cloud infrastructure. Two
AWS certifications and a year of self-directed practice. Looking for a junior or
associate-level cloud or DevOps role. I am aware I am starting again and I am not looking
for a title.

EXPERIENCE

Sarvoday Engineering Works, Ahmedabad
Maintenance Engineer | March 2018 - November 2024
- Responsible for preventive and breakdown maintenance across a plant running three CNC
  lines and an assembly section.
- Maintained the maintenance management system records and produced monthly downtime
  reports for the plant head.
- Wrote the preventive maintenance schedules that the shift technicians followed.
- Part of the on-call escalation for line stoppages, including night shifts.
- Trained six technicians on the new machine control systems after the 2021 line upgrade.

Career break | December 2024 - present
Family caregiving responsibility for eleven months, during which I completed the AWS
certifications below and built the projects listed. Available to start immediately.

Meridian Auto Components, Rajkot
Graduate Engineer Trainee, then Junior Maintenance Engineer | July 2013 - August 2016
- Shop floor maintenance of hydraulic presses and conveyor systems.
- Documented fault histories and root cause findings.

Career break | September 2016 - February 2018
Eighteen months. Relocated after marriage and took time to find a role in the new city.

CERTIFICATIONS
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, June 2025
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, January 2025
Linux Foundation Introduction to Kubernetes (edX, completed), 2025

SELF-DIRECTED PROJECTS

Home lab
- Three-node Kubernetes cluster built with kubeadm on refurbished mini PCs. Running
  Prometheus, Grafana and a few small services I wrote to have something to monitor.

Terraform practice repository
- Terraform configuration that stands up a VPC, two subnets, a security group and an EC2
  instance on AWS. Written to understand the resource graph rather than to deploy anything
  real. Public on GitHub.

Bash automation scripts
- Scripts I wrote at the plant to parse machine log exports and produce the downtime
  summary that I had previously assembled by hand each month.

EDUCATION
B.E. Mechanical Engineering, L. D. College of Engineering, Gujarat Technological University,
2009 - 2013

SKILLS
AWS (EC2, VPC, S3, IAM at certification level), Linux, Bash, Docker, Kubernetes (home lab),
Terraform (practice), Git, Prometheus and Grafana (home lab), maintenance planning,
technical documentation, on-call escalation
jd_text:
Senior DevOps Engineer
Pune (Hybrid) | Cloud Infrastructure | 30 - 45 LPA

We run the infrastructure for a healthcare SaaS platform serving hospital groups across
India and the Gulf. Uptime commitments are contractual and audited. The infrastructure team
is five engineers and we are hiring a sixth at senior level to take ownership of a domain
rather than to be assigned work.

This is not a role we can train someone into. We have said yes to junior applicants before
and it was unfair to them, because the team does not have the capacity to supervise
somebody through their first production incident at two in the morning.

You will own
- Our multi-account AWS estate: 40+ accounts under Control Tower, with the landing zone,
  networking and IAM boundaries that go with that
- Production Kubernetes on EKS across four regions, including upgrades and capacity planning
- The Terraform codebase, roughly 60 modules, and the review standard for changes to it
- CI/CD for 30 services across GitLab CI and Argo CD, including the progressive delivery
  and rollback path
- The observability stack: Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, Loki and OpenTelemetry tracing
- Security and compliance evidence: we are audited against HIPAA and ISO 27001 and the
  infrastructure team produces a lot of that evidence
- Primary on-call in a five-person rotation, for a platform where an outage is a clinical
  risk, not an inconvenience

Requirements
- 6+ years in DevOps, SRE or cloud infrastructure engineering, in production environments
  with paying customers
- Expert AWS across compute, networking, IAM and multi-account governance
- Kubernetes in production at scale. Not a home lab, not a bootcamp cluster, not CKA alone.
  We will ask you about a cluster upgrade that went wrong
- Terraform at module-authoring and code-review level, including state management strategy
  across environments
- Strong Linux systems knowledge and confident scripting in Python or Go
- Production incident response experience, with examples you can talk through in detail
- Experience in a regulated environment: healthcare, financial services or similar

Highly desirable
- Multi-region active-active architecture
- Service mesh, Istio or Linkerd
- Thanos, Mimir or another long-term metrics store
- Policy as code: OPA, Kyverno
- HIPAA, HITRUST or ISO 27001 audit participation
- Cost governance across a large account estate

Please note: we read every application, but we are not able to consider candidates without
production infrastructure experience for this position. If you are early in a transition
into cloud, we would rather tell you that now than after four rounds.
